videos.title: Why He's the Most Trusted Man in Design
videos.why: A short documentary about a designer known for spotting good work early, and the curation habits behind his eye.

videos.title: Outcome-Oriented Design: The Era of AI Design
videos.why: How design work shifts in the AI era, from drawing single screens to defining adaptive frameworks that respond to each person's goals.

podcasts.episode: Sara Vienna - Taste, Meaning, and How to Stand Out in an AI world
podcasts.why: Metalab's chief design officer on design that makes people feel something, and on keeping the heartbeat of a brand as AI reshapes the work.

podcasts.episode: The design process is dead. Here’s what’s replacing it. | Jenny Wen (head of design at Claude)
podcasts.why: The design lead for Claude on why the classic discover, mock and iterate process is becoming obsolete, and what a designer's day at Anthropic looks like.

reads.title: Taste for Makers
reads.why: A clear argument that good taste is real and can be learned, with a list of what good design tends to have in common across fields.

reads.title: Good design
reads.why: Dieter Rams' ten principles of good design, short enough to reread whenever you judge your own work.

reads.title: Improving frontend design through Skills
reads.why: Why AI coding tools drift towards a generic look and how to steer them with specific guidance on typography, colour, motion and backgrounds.
